brief: Today's news covers New Zealand's end of greyhound racing, devastating wildfires in Spokane, and a fraud case tied to AI chatbots, alongside research on data visualization and AI-mediated communication.
news_summary: New Zealand's final greyhound race marks the start of rehoming efforts, while Spokane wildfires leave destruction and an arson arrest. Additional stories include AI-linked bank fraud, heatstroke deaths of zoo lions, and political controversies in Australia and beyond.
papers_summary: Research highlights the 'doer effect' in programming, chart type definitions, and data visualization on foldable devices, plus a study on loss of authorship in AI-mediated communication.
